description: Kinkerstraat 1895-1897 narrow houses on dark brick (black-painted 28, 236-242; dark brown 26, 69-71): 2 axes, segmental windows under white blocked heads (springers + keystone) or tall white keystones, white sills and frames on a dark wall, cream cornice; crowns: a pediment dormer, a neck gable with an attic light; shop or house ground

neck-gable.note: 206-242 pand 2 (237297, black-painted) and 5 (152992): a neck gable with one attic light, top ~2.5 m over the cornice

rhythm.roofline: cream cornice; pediment dormer or neck gable
schemaLimits: white sills are plain slabs (the 26 consoles are windowSills: consoles, which needs a surround storey)
the decorative dark rubbed-brick arch band of 26 is not drawn

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 2-3 (zoom): 28 black-painted brick with tall white keystones over flat heads, 26 brown brick, white keystones and console sills
strip.jpg 2024-12-11 pands 1-5 (zoom): white blocked heads (two springers + keystone) over every window, white frames, dark wall; detect-house-types kinker-206-242 type A
strip.jpg 2024-11-29 pand 3 (zoom): blocked heads on brown brick, 7 axes over three modules

schemaLimits: the eared window surrounds the plan expected were not found on any Kinkerstraat strip; the white dressing here is blocked heads and keystones
notes: Palette: strip medians from scripts/block-face/palette-from-strip.ts (staging/street-types/kinkerstraat/palette.json) (236471 black-painted, 158140 dark brown); stone = band-row median of the group (n=3).
black-painted: wallMaterial painted-brick (Oud-West 1900 lane's key, merged 2026-10-14) instead of the stucco slot, so the measured near-black paint is exported unclamped over brick joints.

White heads (kit lane 2026-10-14): the blocked heads are archRing style springers + keystone (two small white springers, about 0.12 x 0.15 m at the jamb, measured on kinker-206-242 pands 1-5 at 64 px/m); stone = paint from palette-from-strip.ts: 236471 #e2e1d5, 158140 #e3e1d5 (no band rows on either: accent = frame paint, ratio 1), stoneMaterial painted.
